newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines vows to fight looming water crisis.
newsitem.headline: Philippines vows to fight looming water crisis.

text.p: The Philippines vowed on Tuesday to curb the pending water crisis and not to relive the agony of the power crisis which crippled the country in early 1990s.
In his speech before the National Water Summit, Philippine president Fidel Ramos urged policy makers to come up with a comprehensive action plan to conserve the water supply in the country.

"If there is a lesson we have gained from the power crisis that has almost brought our country to its knees some years ago, it is that of the value of anticipation and forward looking planning, preparation and taking preventive measures now are definitely better .. than engaging in damage control later," he said.
In an executive order, Ramos created a presidential task force on water resources management to ensure the efficient development and management of the water resources.
He said signs of a water shortage were already evident with the recent outbreak of water-borne diseases.
"All the breakthroughs and successes we have made in the economic and social fields in the past few years can be put at risk should we face a prolonged water shortage," he warned.
